title: ✈️ Sky-High Sips: When Drinking and Flying Was Just... Normal?
content:
In response to about an AskMetaFilter question titled "When did airliner pilots stop drinking, on-the-job? Did they ever?", Jane the Brown posted a comment that touches on just a few subjects, such as the history of drinking and driving, alcohol culture of the 1970s, aviation and alcohol use, pilot drinking scandals, functional alcoholism, cultural shifts in alcohol use, and drunk driving laws of the 1970s.

So pour yourself a beverage, turn off plane (or car), and discover fascinating details about drinking, history, and culture.
author: Brandon Blatcher
